thread:
elaine_cs: Heads-up — Bluecrest Labs going live EU launch tomorrow 09:00 CET. Customer asked for short-term rate limit increase and IP allowlist for their peering. Can we do a provisional bump + add IPs to allowlist until Mon 09:00 CET?

sam_eng: Adding details pls: what's current qps and target? Also which region routing?

elaine_cs: Current plan: burst to 800 qps (from 120 qps) for 24h, region: eu-west-1 preferred, fallback eu-central. IPs: 35.189.120.10, 35.189.120.11 (their peering).

mike_ops: @sam_eng we should route them to eu-west dedicated pool?

elaine_cs: It's hosted API but enterprise tier; they want regional routing to eu-west edge for latency. Not full Dedicated.

sam_eng: Ok. We can add an edge allowlist and temporary rate-window raise. Need change request in infra-ticket + approval. I can do a quick canary with deploy-bot.

sara_csm: I've scheduled a launch check-in at 08:15 CET and told them we'll confirm config by 07:30.

elaine_cs: Also capturing feedback: they said dashboard metrics lag ~30s in Console which worries them for throttling. Noted for product.

sam_eng: Noted. I'll triage telemetry lag separately. For the allowlist, want this JSON snippet to apply?

sam_eng: ```
{ "customer": "bluecrest", "allowlist_ips": ["35.189.120.10","35.189.120.11"], "region_routing": "eu-west-1", "temporary_rate": {"qps":800, "duration_hours":24, "expires":"2026-03-22T08:59:00Z"} }
```

deploy-bot: change-request created: INFRA-4829 by sam_eng. Staging rollout scheduled at 03:55 UTC.

mike_ops: I'll provision the edge rule and apply the allowlist during the maintenance window. @elaine_cs confirm IPs one more time pls.

elaine_cs: Confirmed. Also customer asked for an explicit automatic revoke after 24h. Please ensure TTL enforcement.

sam_eng: We'll set expiry flag. I will also add a short rollback plan: revert qps to 120 and remove allowlist if errors exceed 5% 5xxs in 10m.

sara_csm: Renewal note: customer flagged onboarding delays as a risk. Positive launch reduces churn probability but we should follow up on the Console lag feedback next week. Adding to renewal tracker.

elaine_cs: Thanks team. Will post post-launch checklist after the 08:15 call. :rocket:

sam_eng: deployed to staging, will promote to prod at 07:00 CET pending no errors.

deploy-bot: prod rollout complete — INFRA-4829 — 2876543235.

mike_ops: Allowlist applied, routing set to eu-west-1, qps=800 for 24h. Monitoring now.

sam_eng: Seeing normal error rate. Dashboard shows a temporary metric lag spike, but no throttles.

elaine_cs: Customer confirms lower latency and that requests are flowing. They appreciated the auto-revoke.

sara_csm: Captured feedback: Console metrics lag + clearer TTL visibility for temporary grants. I'll open a product feedback ticket.

elaine_cs: Closing the loop — follow-up scheduled next Wed. Thanks. :thumbsup:
